parts.text:
Done. Module `textconv` created with `golang.org/x/text v0.42.0`.

- `textconv.go` — `Lookup` (13 named encodings), `Decode`/`Encode`, `DecodeString`, `Convert` (decode + normalize), `Normalize`, `NormalizeReader`, `IsNormalized`, and `ToNFC`/`ToNFD`/`ToNFKC`/`ToNFKD`.
- `textconv_test.go` — coverage for lookup, Latin-1/Shift-JIS round trips, normalization forms, reader, and convert.

`gofmt`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./...` all pass. No git commit made.

Want this as a runnable CLI (`cmd/`) instead of a library package?
